content_data.meeting_title: AR Rendering Pipeline Optimization & Unity Integration Review
agenda_items: Address WebXR deployment strategy for client demo environment
Discuss Unity 6 migration timeline and compatibility issues
key_decisions: Adopt Manomotion SDK for hand tracking rather than building custom solution in-house
Migrate to Unity 6 rendering pipeline within the next 3 months to leverage improved AR Foundation features
Postpone iOS deployment until spatial computing APIs stabilize over the next 6 weeks
action_items: Document API endpoints and data schemas for client integration by next sprint
Prepare technical proof-of-concept for WebXR implementation within 10 days
